sourceRule: ButtonGroup renders div role=group; orientation horizontal is the visual default, vertical stacks controls. ButtonGroupSeparator defaults vertical and composes Separator. ButtonGroupText uses useRender default div. Neither group orientation nor borders register toolbar roving focus, a radio choice or shared disabled/value state.
keyboardAndFocus: Each actual Button/link/input keeps its native keyboard, focus, disabled and callback contract. Tab visits enabled controls in DOM order. The reference supplies a group label identifying their relationship; group orientation changes layout without intercepting arrow keys.
referenceComposition: Report
protocol: SCXML consumes actual source/native transaction observations; callback objects remain original. Sends document observed callbacks, not second DOM dispatches. Parent-controlled props alone synchronize authoritative values. HTML/CSS is a semantic projection; executable behavior uses actual pinned React wrappers.

group.description: Actual named role=group, not an automatic toolbar/selection controller.

text.description: Actual useRender text addon or explicit native override.

separator.description: Actual composed Separator with independent orientation.

action.description: Explicit caller native Button children, with their own focus/actions.
